verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a REST API v1 giving "programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources." A GraphQL API, an open-source CLI, an S3-compatible storage API, and MCP servers also cover Pods, Serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes, registries, file transfer and account info. Together these come close to UI parity for the core compute surfaces. Missing for 10: no evidence that billing/auto-pay and Instant Clusters can be managed via API, no published OpenAPI spec found (probe returned 404), and no independent or hands-on confirmation of full UI parity.
